modules.description: FANS 1/A CPDLC pages and fixes for the stock FMS datalink: DO-258A request texts, WHEN CAN WE, REPORT, POSITION REPORT, EMERGENCY, VOICE, loadable DIRECT TO clearances, STANDBY and response-attribute fixes.

included: unknown or empty CPDLC response attribute means no response required (was: response required)
STANDBY is kept as the message status until the final response and stays selectable until sent
no automatic ABORTED status for unanswered ATC uplinks; unanswered crew requests still expire
ATC prompt on the DLNK-APPLICATION MENU when CPDLC is FANS (CDU without ATC key)
Boeing FANS ATC INDEX layout: EMERGENCY, POS REPORT, REQUEST, WHEN CAN WE, REPORT, FREE TEXT, LOG, LOGON/STATUS, VOICE
new pages WHEN CAN WE, REPORT, POSITION REPORT, EMERGENCY, VOICE with a shared VERIFY/SEND page (DO-258A downlink texts)
CMU request page 2 with BLOCK, HEADING, OFFSET, WEATHER DEVIATION and AT PILOTS DISCRETION; DO-258A request texts (CLIMB TO / DESCENT TO / KT / M.xx)
the same pages reachable from the DLK ATC MENU and the CPDLC REPORTS/REQUESTS menu
loadable PROCEED DIRECT TO clearances on the CMU/DLK message page (=LOAD / LOAD>), fixed ident parsing and armed intercept course for the stock LOAD
known baseline reporting plus structural validation of every owned patch block
notIncluded: changes to the Hoppie transport plugin, the tablet or zibomod.xpl
ATN B1 message-set restriction: every CMU/DLK layout gets the full page set
complete Zibo, LevelUp or X-Plane aircraft files
